sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM superpower sp 
    WHERE hp.power_id = sp.id AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
) AND s.height_cm > 200
